name: Green-veg & chicken glass-noodle stir-fry — soy-free (clean sauce)

source.author: Hebrew recipe (screenshot)
source.notes: Soy-FREE ('clean sauce') variant of green_veg_chicken_glass_noodle_stirfry — identical chicken + green veg, but the 8 tbsp soy is replaced with 1 level tsp salt + juice of ½ lemon + ¼ cup water. This is the direct fix to that recipe's sodium problem. Method not shown; standard stir-fry assumed. Servings/oil retention estimated.

steps: Sear the chicken strips until cooked; set aside.
Stir-fry garlic + chili, then green beans, zucchini, broccoli until crisp-tender.
Add the soaked glass noodles with the ¼ cup water, salt, pepper and sesame oil; toss.
Fold in spinach + green onion until wilted; return chicken, finish with the lemon juice.

him.verdict: The better version of the two — everything great about the soy stir-fry (44→42 g protein, ~5 g fiber/serving, big green-veg load, folate/iron/vitamin C) but the sodium problem is SOLVED: ~417 mg/serving vs ~1,133 mg in the soy version, because 8 tbsp soy became 1 tsp salt + lemon + water. You give up only ~2 g protein/serving for a ~700 mg sodium cut — a clear win. The lemon also brightens it and adds vitamin C. Only remaining lever is the frying oil (~14 g fat).
flags: sodium fixed (~417 mg vs 1,133 in the soy version)
suggested_mods: Adopt THIS over the soy version — strictly better on sodium for ~2 g less protein
Trim frying oil toward 2 tbsp if you want it leaner
Salt to taste — you can go under 1 tsp and lean on the lemon/chili/garlic

her_preconception.verdict: Now the best preconception main in the library, full stop. Same folate powerhouse (spinach + broccoli + green beans, ~80 mcg DFE/serving), iron (~3.2 mg) paired with vitamin C (~45 mg, now boosted by the lemon) for absorption, lean protein + choline — but WITHOUT the sodium that held the soy version back. Fully cooked, no safety flags. This is the one to make for her.
prenatal_highlights: high folate (spinach + broccoli + green beans) — top preconception nutrient
iron paired with vitamin C (veg + lemon) for absorption
reasonable sodium (~417 mg) — the key improvement over the soy version
suggested_mods: Best-for-her main — make this instead of the soy version
Serve promptly so the folate-rich greens aren't overcooked

adopted_note: Adopted into the rotation 2026-08-22 (user plans to try it this week) as the best-scoring main + best preconception dish in the library. Scales with chicken weight (veg + sauce scale alongside). Prefer this over the soy version (green_veg_chicken_glass_noodle_stirfry), which stays reference-only. Per-serving reference: ~467 kcal, 42 g protein, ~5 g fiber, ~417 mg sodium per ~400 g (1 kg raw chicken ÷6).
cooking_guide: Prep everything first. Soak the glass noodles in warm water until pliable, drain, and snip shorter.
Blanch or steam the broccoli and green beans ~2 min, then shock in cold water to keep them bright green and crisp.
Pat the chicken dry and sear in a hot wok in a single layer until just cooked; remove and set aside.
Stir-fry the garlic and chili briefly, then the zucchini and blanched greens over high heat 2-3 min.
Add the noodles with the 1/4 cup water, salt, pepper and sesame oil, and toss — the water keeps the noodles from drying out.
Return the chicken, then fold in the spinach and green onion until just wilted.
Finish off the heat with the fresh lemon/lime juice — it brightens everything and boosts iron absorption. Serve promptly.
Tip: salt to taste — you can go light and lean on the lemon, chili and garlic for flavor.
